;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[President of Afghanistan|Afghan presidential]] spokesman Sediq Sediqqi says that the government rejects the proposed "reduction in violence" by the [[Taliban]] as an "ambiguous term with no legal or military parameters". On Friday, the Taliban proposed a ten-day truce and to hold follow-up discussions with [[Afghan government]] officials. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/afghan-government-demands-long-term-ceasefire-taliban-200117083410030.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Yemen Civil War (2015–present)]]
**[[January 2020 Ma'rib attack|2020 Ma'rib attack]]
***Eighty [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|military personnel]] are killed by [[ballistic missile]]s and [[drone strike]]s in an attack reportedly carried out by the [[Houthi]]s against a military camp in the [[Yemen]]i city of [[Ma'rib]], according to Saudi state TV. The Houthis have not claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51166943 (BBC News)]
* [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**[[2020 Afgooye bombing]]
***An [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[car bomb]]ing kills four people and injures at least 20 others near [[Afgooye]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/01/18/Car-bomb-targeting-Turkish-contractors-explodes-in-Somali-town.html (Al Arabiya)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Megxit]]
** Officials within [[Buckingham Palace]] announced that effective around Q2 2020, [[Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex|Prince Harry]] and his wife [[Meghan, Duchess of Sussex]] will retain, but will no longer publicly use, the [[Style (form of address)|style]] [[Royal Highness|His/Her Royal Highness]], and will no longer receive public funds for royal duties. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-51163865 (BBC News)]
** The couple will also repay [[pound sterling|£]]2.4 million of public money spent on renovating [[Frogmore Cottage]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2020/0118/1108328-harry-meghan-royals/ (RTÉ News and Current Affairs)]
** The couple will keep their titles as Duke and Duchess of Sussex. While Prince Harry will lose all his [[British Armed Forces|military]] appointments, he will remain a [[British prince|prince]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/harry-and-meghan-to-lose-royal-funds-and-hrh-titles-from-spring-11912020 (Sky News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2020 North American storm complex|Winter Storm Jacob]]
**A historic blizzard strikes [[Atlantic Canada]], with [[St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador|St. John's]] in [[Newfoundland and Labrador|Newfoundland]] worst affected – over {{convert|30|in|cm}} of snow fell during the day, breaking the city's all-time daily snowfall record. 21,000 homes are without power and one person is missing. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-18-newfoundland-blizzard-record-daily-snow-st-johns (The Weather Channel)]
**High winds and heavy snowfall impact the Midwest and mid-Atlantic states of the United States, with the heaviest snowfall recorded in [[Chicago]], [[Cleveland]] and [[Detroit]]. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast (The Weather Channel)]
